messages.subject: Calderdale House — amended contract (our mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Elena,

Our client has reviewed the draft and, in light of the settled Harlow Reed review and current Manchester office yields, is not willing to proceed at £8.3m. We attach our mark-up reflecting a price of £8,450,000 (deposit £845,000) and a tightening of the VAT clause so that the buyer bears interest and any HMRC penalty if it is late providing its option to tax. Other changes are minor.

The price is firm; on that basis our client will hold the rest of the timetable.

Regards,
Alistair

messages.subject: FW: Calderdale House — amended contract (our mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah — Pemberton Rowe have come back at £8.45m, up £150k. On the rent roll of £601,500 that's still a ~6.9% net initial yield after costs, which is defensible against the comps. The VAT amendment is reasonable in principle but I'll resist the open-ended penalty exposure. Shall I sound out Frances on the price?

E.
